title: Refined chirality-mixing structural rationals
verdict: The refined beta_pi chirality-mixing form with (a_vac, a_mat) = (143/144, 23/48) = ((2^d*N_gen^2-1)/(2^d*N_gen^2), (2d*N_gen-1)/(4d*N_gen)) matches all 8 regimes with mean residual 0.60%, a 5.3x improvement over the canonical (15/16, 1/2) form. The vacuum-side anchor a_vac=143/144 connects the 2^d*N_gen^2=144 'Cl(1,3) module x family' scale; the matter-side anchor a_mat=23/48 connects the 2*d*N_gen=24 'spacetime-doubled times family' scale. The alpha/beta ~ N^(-2/5) power-law verifies cleanly with R^2 = 0.9912, exponent matching -2/5 within 1.25%. D_Omega chirality mixing is less clean (non-monotonic per-regime) but linear fit b_vac~0.754, b_mat~0.334.
